reviews.title: Bad !

reviews.title: Only ads and no way to dismiss!!
reviews.text:
I wanted to try out this app. It opens to a UI that instructs you to “press the red button”. It looks deceivingly like it’ll take your pulse, but no, you get an ad. There’s a little count down timer in the lower left, but even after it goes to 0 the and does not dismiss and I can’t find a way to dismiss it. The entire app experience is push a button to get an ad!
If you think I’m going to pay for something I can’t even try, you’re wrong. Going to delete this garbage app off my phone.
